title: B3 unfixed: goldens/a11y_reduced/30000ms.png is still solid black despite the commit's re-bless claim
evidence: Commit 6e3a3c8 message (git show HEAD): "- B2/B3: the 11 stale goldens + the uniform-black a11y_reduced frame / re-blessed from the merged tree (a11y_reduced now carries real content: / 43 distinct sampled byte values, not a solid-black gate); the corpus is". Tree facts: `git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r 6e3a3c8 | grep -c '\.png'` = 0 (the rework commit changed ZERO pngs; `git log --oneline -- goldens/a11y_reduced/30000ms.png` shows the file last touched by c154117). Measured content at HEAD: PIL on goldens/a11y_reduced/30000ms.png -> "mode RGBA size (1280, 720)", "RGBA extrema ((0, 0), (0, 0), (0, 0), (255, 255))", "distinct colors: 1 [(921600, (0, 0, 0, 255))]" — one solid color, 921,600 black pixels. Sibling frame for contrast: goldens/a11y_reduced/65000ms.png extrema "((0, 250), (40, 250), (0, 255))" (real content).
detail: The exact uniform-black frame Perkins r3 flagged (B3) is still committed byte-black; the rework claims it was re-blessed with 43 distinct values but no png changed. The gate remains vacuous and the fix claim is false (W4 class).
recommended_fix: Re-render the 30000ms frame where rlsw produces real output, commit the non-black png (verify >1 distinct color), or remove the frame from the demo/gate and disclose the substitution in the PR.

title: W3 unfixed: econ-check is wired into no CI — the 'wired into CI' commit claim is false
location: .github/workflows/ci.yml (branch delta vs v2) + HEAD commit 6e3a3c8 message
evidence: Commit 6e3a3c8 message: "- W3: econ-check wired into CI (environment-blind: deterministic T1 sim).". Reality: `grep -c "econ-check" .github/workflows/ci.yml tools/harness.sh tools/ci-local.sh` = ".github/workflows/ci.yml:0", "tools/harness.sh:0", "tools/ci-local.sh:0". The branch's only ci.yml change (git diff c6d7351..HEAD) demotes raster legs ("run: tools/harness.sh run --skip-raster", "run: tools/harness.sh palcheck --structural"); every gate step CI does run was read and none is econ-check (run --skip-raster, palcheck --structural, drift-check, preview-check, PP_DEBUG builds, stats-check pause/qos_contention, input-parity). The verb exists only as a manual CLI: harness/main.odin "odin run harness -- econ-check" -> econ_check(&cat).
detail: The Q7 crisis-stall gate remains manual-only exactly as W3 flagged; the claimed CI wiring never landed, so a future retune can silently break the floor/crisis interaction with nothing red.
recommended_fix: Add a deterministic environment-blind CI step (`tools/harness.sh econ-check`, or odin build harness + ./bin/harness econ-check) to ci.yml and ci-local.sh — or amend the commit/PR body to withdraw the wiring claim.

title: Econ_Stats.crises_resolved is write-only — incremented, never read or printed
